# Pinned Trader snapshot

Do not edit `purplehat-trader/`.

Source of truth: https://github.com/BVoges182/purplehat-trading.git

Commit: `603b207ffa18cc151701bd79659967bff9779584` on `work/trader-deployment`.

This folder is the packaged Trader release from that commit. Purple Hat Trading stays a separate repository. The website mounts it at `/trader` and `/trader/api`. Strategy code is not developed here.

Hashes for the pinned files are in `trader.pin.json` at the website repository root.
